answer.reason: The verses tell of the building of the house by Solomon, the ark and glory filling it at its dedication, and its burning by the Babylonians.

clauses.english: was built by Solomon over seven years
clauses.quote: So was he seven years in building it.

clauses.english: was filled with the glory of the LORD when the ark was brought in
clauses.quote: the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.

clauses.english: was dedicated by Solomon with a great sacrifice of oxen and sheep
clauses.quote: So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.

clauses.english: was burnt, and its bronze pillars and sea broken up, by the Chaldeans
clauses.quote: And he burnt the house of the LORD

doubts: Many marked verses (e.g. Hezekiah's prayer, Josiah's reforms, Joash's repairs, the vessels taken to Babylon) are omitted as secondary events.
Marked verses such as Ezekiel 8-11 visions, Ezra 3:12 (the second house) and Jeremiah's 'temple of the LORD' words concern the temple generally or the rebuilt house, and were left out.
